column1: # scripts/quest-devices.tsv — MDM Quest/Oculus headset device catalog
# (--device-class quest targets for scripts/phone-wizard.sh).
# Provenance: verified 2026-07-19 against Meta Horizon OS developer docs +
# device build-prop dumps (FreeXR eureka/panther toolchains, XDA): the Meta
# Quest 3 family Horizon OS ships today. The wizard FAILS CLOSED on any
# codename not listed here (exit 4) — same policy as phone-devices.tsv.
# Identification facts the driver enforces in code (not here):
#   - USB vendor id 2833 (Oculus/Meta — the Linux udev ATTR{idVendor} value);
#   - adb: ro.product.device = <codename>, ro.product.manufacturer = oculus
#     (Horizon OS reports the pre-rebrand "oculus" string; the driver also
#     accepts "meta" case-insensitively in case a future build renames it).
# NOTE the deliberate catalog split: `panther` is ALSO the Pixel 7's GrapheneOS
# codename in phone-devices.tsv. The --device-class flag selects WHICH catalog
# a codename resolves against, and the manufacturer probe (require_quest_device)
# keeps a Pixel from ever being driven down the quest path — codenames alone
# are NOT globally unique across vendors.
# To extend: confirm the new headset's ro.product.device value from an
# authoritative source (Meta developer docs / a real device probe), then append
# a row below.
# Format: one device per row, exactly two TAB-separated columns:
#   <codename>
# '#' lines and blank lines are ignored.
eureka
panther
